title: Deferral Fee on Kestrel Auto Finance Retail Installment Contracts
content:
**Fee clause.** A deferral on Kestrel Auto Finance Retail Installment Contracts moves the installment at the next due date to the end of the contract; the next due date and the maturity date each move one month later and the deferrals used rise by one. The deferral fee is the tier's deferral fee, assessed as a deferral fee entry for the deferred installment when it is above zero. A deferral fee is never below zero and is rounded to the cent as the last step; a fee of zero books no deferral-fee entry.

## Tier deferral fee

| Tier | Deferral fee (USD) | Deferral-fee entry |
|---|---|---|
| Kestrel Finance Tier E | 35.00 | booked for the deferred installment |
| Kestrel Finance Tier D | 35.00 | booked for the deferred installment |
| Kestrel Finance Tier C | 25.00 | booked for the deferred installment |
| Kestrel Finance Tier B | 25.00 | booked for the deferred installment |
| Kestrel Finance Tier A | 0.00 | none |
| Kestrel Finance Tier A+ | 0.00 | none |

## Hypothetical cases

- A Tier C contract with a next due date of 2026-04-20 and a maturity date of 2029-11-20 is deferred: the 2026-04-20 installment moves to the end, the next due date becomes 2026-05-20, the maturity date 2029-12-20, the deferrals used rise by one, and a deferral-fee entry of 25.00 is booked for the 2026-04-20 installment.
- The same deferral at Tier A: the dates move in the same way and no deferral-fee entry is booked.
